regime_context: The detector shows a broad metals-led tape: Silver & Royalties and Gold Miners hold nearly identical top momentum scores (2.127 vs 2.093) with the narrowest possible rotation margin (0.034), and both are trend-eligible with high durability bars near 0.7. The absolute-trend gate is validated for this market (gate_helps=true), so the one edge worth trusting is drawdown/shake-out control, not the ranks themselves. Track record shows only 31.2% directional accuracy on 64 calls — leans should be low conviction.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Base Metals & Copper (XBM.TO) closes the gap on the precious-metals pair: it is trend-eligible, score 1.145, but its durability bar (0.56) is well below the leaders and its hurst_tag is mean-revert. If a rotation 'broad' into materials continues and XBM.TO's durability bar climbs above 0.65 while remaining eligible, that would confirm a real handoff from precious metals into base metals — not just rank noise.

theses.subject: Silver & Royalties
theses.thesis: XGD.TO is the sole scorable proxy for both top themes and sits in the validated absolute-trend-eligible zone with a 0.69 durability bar and full breadth (1.0). The trend-gate leg — the only validated edge in this market — is currently on, and crowded=false means no size-down caution is triggered. The call is a gentle continuation lean, not a momentum-return prediction.
evidence: crowded=false with crowding_z 0.8 below the crowded threshold
gate_helps=true on this market (validated risk-control leg)
theses.dissent: The 0.034 rotation margin versus Gold Miners means there is no real separation at the top — leadership is a coin flip, and the shared XGD.TO proxy means both themes collapse into one silver/gold-miner trade. A pullback in precious metals hits the whole complex at once.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO closes below its own 20-day moving average before the check-by date

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners is the challenger one breath behind the leader, also trend-eligible with the highest durability bar in the table (0.73) and full breadth. The rotation view is 'broad' (8 of 16 eligible), so two adjacent precious-metals themes leading is not a fragile one-narrative structure. This is a dispersion-free companion lean to Silver & Royalties via the same proxy.
evidence: durability_bar 0.73, the highest on the table
theses.dissent: Co-holding Silver & Royalties and Gold Miners through one proxy is double-counting a single precious-metals bet. If the metals complex stalls, both positions fall together and the apparent diversification is illusory.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO lags the S&P/TSX Composite by more than 5% before the check-by date

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: Oil & Gas is the only crowded name on the board (crowding_z 1.29, crowded=true) while still trend-eligible. The crowding flag is explicitly a size-down caution, not a fade — so the honest expression is an underweight lean: enough trend support to stay in, enough crowding to cap the position rather than chase it.
evidence: crowded=true with crowding_z 1.29, the highest crowding read on the table
theses.dissent: Crowding has no basket-level forward edge in this framework (backtest_verdict: no_basket_drawdown_edge), so an underweight here is a precaution, not a predictive short. If energy momentum re-accelerates, being underweight costs relative performance for no real downside protection.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO closes at a new 60-day high and holds above it for five consecutive sessions before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
